notes: Identical supplied descriptions and p. 6 locators identify multiple tests without a row-specific discriminator. Candidate relative-liking difference test: F(1, 198) = 3.80, p = .05 (exact equality). Candidate favorite-choice share test: ZMann–Whitney = –2.20, p = .028 (exact equality). No row-specific assignment is justified. The row-specific target test is unresolved. Methods give 200 survey completers, retained only as candidate sample evidence for parent field-scope review; a critical-test analytic N is not separately explicit here. The one-person exclusion pertains specifically to popularity analysis. The 80-person pretest is separate. No N is derived from df or summed groups. Footnote 2 additionally reports absolute-liking preference-ranking F(3, 594) = 376.11, p < .001 and linear contrast F(1, 198) = 670.07, p < .001; neither selected. Study 2 Web Appendix mediation coefficients also do not disambiguate the assigned rows. All candidate values remain unassigned. PDF page 6 rendered and inspected for layout.
